## Use When

Use when related controls belong to the same operational group.

## Do

- Give each group a direct legend.
- Keep supporting text concise.
- Split unrelated settings into separate fieldsets.

## Do Not

- Use one fieldset for the entire page.
- Treat Fieldset as a generic layout frame.

## Example

Promotion rules and escalation contacts should stay separate.
